home.title: Home
home.description: A European Erasmus+ project creating inclusive pathways from vocational training to real employment for young adults with cognitive disabilities.

the-project.title: The Project
the-project.description: Why the transition from protected learning to real work stays difficult, and how INCLUDE works on both sides with a corporate-led model.

the-pathway.title: The Pathway
the-pathway.description: A three-phase vocational continuum: Protected Gym, pre-corporate preparation and work-based learning in SMEs, supported by mentoring and competence tools.

results-and-tools.title: Results & Tools
results-and-tools.description: The public repository of INCLUDE outputs: research, the Readiness Index, ESCO-mapped profiles, mentoring framework, Technical Passport, Toolkit and White Paper.

ready-for-inclusion.title: Ready for Inclusion
ready-for-inclusion.description: Practical guidance for SMEs that want to start inclusive work-based learning: readiness, tutoring, peer learning and the Ambassador Network.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Six organisations from four European countries: coordination, research, facilitation, assessment and SME engagement behind INCLUDE.
